LanguageData.MeleeAnimRenderFix.MenuHideSettings.Rend: (Melee Animation Render Fix) Hides every Melee Animation right-click option (lasso, execute, skills) unless the selected pawn is drafted.\nAutomatic lassos and executions are not affected.
(Melee Animation Render Fix) Hides greyed-out right-click options such as "Cannot lasso: ..." and "Cannot execute: ...". Options that can be used still show.
(Melee Animation Render Fix) Hides the "Lasso ..." right-click options.\nAutomatic lassos are not affected.
(Melee Animation Render Fix) Hides the "Execute ..." right-click options.\nAutomatic executions are not affected; use Enable Executions to turn the whole system off.
(Melee Animation Render Fix) Hides the weapon skill right-click options (unique skills).
